panels.title: Runs per hour
panels.description: Stage runs in the hour before each point, by stage and project.

targets.expr: sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h))

panels.title: Errors

(
sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} offset 1h))
or
0 * sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h))
)
/
(sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h)) > 0)

targets.expr:

)
or
(
(max by (project, wave) (last_over_time(terragucci_wave_waiting_since_seconds{project=~"$project"}[7d]))) > on (project, wave) (max by (project, wave) (last_over_time(terragucci_wave_settled_seconds{project=~"$project"}[7d])))
))

targets.expr:
time() - ((
(max by (project, wave) (last_over_time(terragucci_wave_waiting_since_seconds{project=~"$project"}[7d]))) unless on (project, wave) (max by (project, wave) (last_over_time(terragucci_wave_settled_seconds{project=~"$project"}[7d])))
)
or
(
(max by (project, wave) (last_over_time(terragucci_wave_waiting_since_seconds{project=~"$project"}[7d]))) > on (project, wave) (max by (project, wave) (last_over_time(terragucci_wave_settled_seconds{project=~"$project"}[7d])))
))

panels.title: Wave runs by result
panels.description: tf-apply runs over the range: applied, nothing to apply, waiting for an approval, refused because the plans moved after approval, or failed.

targets.expr: sum by (terragucci_project, terragucci_result) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset $__range, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Refused and failed waves
panels.description: Wave runs refused or failed in the hour before each point.

targets.expr:
sum by (terragucci_result) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_result=~"refused|failed", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_result=~"refused|failed", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_result=~"refused|failed", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_result=~"refused|failed", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h))
or
label_replace(0 * sum(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_project=~"$project"}), "terragucci_result", "refused", "", "")
or
label_replace(0 * sum(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage="tf-apply", terragucci_project=~"$project"}), "terragucci_result", "failed", "", "")
